credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Dress, full length grey/blue patterned, long sleeve, button down smock with seven button holes, one or two missing buttons? Two rounded patch pockets on front, long sleeves gathered at wrist seams, button closures at wrist, slits at bottom he. Band collar. Radial patter with stripes. Pattern is "NAOJA" By Vuokko Nurmesniemi, designed 1959. Dress probably designed by Annika Rimala and probably the "Karutakkj" Model from 1961. Marimekko design.
title: Dress, smock
